title: The Bread Sponge under the Towel
youtube_title: The Bread Sponge under the Towel | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Leaving a cover on is a kind of trust.
summary: At a quiet craft corner with paper, paste, and a wooden rack, Tala wants to check on a bread sponge napping under a floury towel before it is ready. With Auntie Luz nearby, Tala leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
